tool_args.rationale: The thermal-fin bridge maps to the inland-hub siphon, but the pilot varies only u_now: s_grad is fixed at 1. The open-branch probe is the lowest-cost available measurement that can resolve the sink-gradient and branch ambiguity before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Thermal-fin bridge to two-layer siphon with positive or negative square-root branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Deferred fitting: all five observations have the same sink gradient, so the sink coefficient and branch behavior cannot be independently identified reliably.
The fixed-gradient pilot also leaves their sink dependence unidentified; the open-branch probe can distinguish these alternatives.
The observed thermal-fin and flux-conservation signatures favor a static siphon bridge over a coupled memory ODE; trajectory measurements are not yet warranted.
